properties.summary: After someone close to them was detained by ICE, this student said it became a lot harder to stay focused in school because they were carrying fear, grief, and stress at the same time.
properties.support_need: Accessible mental health care and trusted community spaces

properties.summary: This response shows how detention and deportation can suddenly change everything at home, especially when other relatives have to step in and take over caregiving or financial responsibilities.
properties.support_need: Family resource support and legal guidance

properties.summary: A loved one's removal created sudden financial pressure, and this response reflects how quickly housing costs, bills, and everyday expenses can become harder to manage.
properties.support_need: Emergency aid and long-term financial support

properties.summary: This student pointed out how hard it can be to find campus support that really understands immigration-related grief, family separation, and how those things can affect school life.
Fear and stigma around detention and deportation made it hard for this family to talk openly about what happened, which made the student feel even more isolated and alone.
properties.support_need: Community spaces that reduce stigma and encourage dialogue
